intuition: Hash each key to a bucket and keep colliding key-value pairs together.

brute_force.approach: Store key-value pairs in one list and linearly search it for each operation.
brute_force.time: put O(n), get O(n), remove O(n)

optimal.approach: Use separate chaining with a fixed array of buckets, updating or removing a matching key within its bucket.
optimal.time: put O(1) average, get O(1) average, remove O(1) average

edge_cases: Putting an existing key replaces its value.
A missing key returns -1 and removing it changes nothing.
